headings.description: Bold, condensed display typography for maximum industrial impact. Used for Hero H1 and major section headers.

body.description: Clean, highly legible grotesque font resembling engineering documents.

mono_accents.description: Used for manifestos, chapter numbers, spec-sheet data, and overlines.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle dark metal texture or noise overlay (opacity 3-5%) across the main background to eliminate digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Industrial grid lines. Use border-collapse patterns. Containers should have distinct 1px solid borders (`border-white/10`) to resemble technical schematics.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for the sticky header and floating interactive elements. Must have `backdrop-blur-xl`, a `bg-slate-950/70` fill, and a 1px inner border (`border-white/10`). Never fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Sharp-edged (no border radius) or slight 2px radius. High contrast. Primary buttons should be Safety Orange with dark text, or transparent with a Safety Orange border and hover fill.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: py-24 or py-32 for sections, gap-8 to gap-16 for grids.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the Products section (7 items). Use a combination of col-span-2 and col-span-4 to create an asymmetrical technical grid. Ensure all items have a `border-r` and `border-b` mimicking a blueprint.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for text to maintain an engineering report aesthetic. Center alignment only used for the Marquee.

motion.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY: Use `lenis` for premium smooth scrolling momentum.
motion.kinetic_hero: Line-by-line text reveal using framer-motion. Wrap lines in `overflow-hidden` spans. Animate inner text `y: '100%'` to `y: '0'` with an ease-out-cubic transition (duration: 0.8s, stagger: 0.1s).
motion.parallax: Use framer-motion `useScroll` and `useTransform` to create subtle parallax on hero images and large typography backgrounds.
motion.editorial_marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee`. Slow, continuous scroll. Text should be large outlined typography (`text-transparent stroke-white stroke-1`) or solid Safety Orange.

global.header: Sticky with backdrop blur, Company Logo, Desktop Nav Links (Home, About, Products, Contact), and a 'Get Quote' CTA.
global.footer: Massive footer. `py-32`. Huge 'DHARMA COMPOSITE' typography. Grid containing address, contact, and quick links.

sections: Hero: Kinetic typography ('ENGINEERED COMPOSITE SOLUTIONS'), subtle 3D/parallax background of industrial dark factory.
Marquee: Scrolling text of the 7 product categories.
Numbered Manifesto: 'Why Us' chapters (01. Precision, 02. Durability, 03. Chemistry).
Product Teaser: Bento grid of top categories.

about.description: Company history, manufacturing capability in Bhiwadi, and mission statement presented in a spec-sheet format.

products.layout: Grid list. Hovering over a row reveals an image associated with the product (framer-motion image follow cursor pattern, or simple fade in on the side).

contact.form: Name, Company, Requirement, Submit. On submit, replace form with a success message ('REQUEST RECEIVED. OUR ENGINEERING TEAM WILL CONTACT YOU SHORTLY.'). No backend email integration.

hero_background.description: Dark, moody industrial factory interior. Use with a heavy slate-950 overlay (e.g., bg-slate-950/70) so the kinetic text pops.

manifesto_texture.description: Abstract dark metal diamond-plate texture for background layers in the Manifesto or About section.

products_tanks.description: Industrial silos/tanks against sky. Use for FRP Tanks and Storage Tanks categories.

products_fittings.description: Industrial gold/orange pipes. Use for FRP Fitting Products.

libraries_and_components.icons: lucide-react (Technical icons like ArrowUpRight, Zap, Shield, Factory)

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`) in CSS.
Do NOT center align the app container. Remove `.App { text-align: center; }`.
All text content should be placed over solid or blurred backgrounds to maintain contrast.
Never use full transparency for header backgrounds. Use `bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl`.
Use framer-motion strictly as direct children of grid containers to prevent layout breaking.
Implement Lenis smooth scroll wrapping the entire app.

Use custom geometric and sharp component styling (not the default Vercel look). Shadcn components must be styled with tailwind overrides for square borders `rounded-none` and industrial borders `border-slate-800`.
